tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Dakshina Kannada Co-operative Milk Producers Union Limited (ENGG)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer must be a minimum three year old registered established service provider.
Tenderer should enclose the details of previously arranged such package programs for minimum 45 passengers preferably to for Govt/Co-operative/Semi Govt organizations
GST Certificate registration certificate must be uploaded.
The tenderer must submit annual turnover certificate of last three 3 years having 5 Lakhs turnover in any one financial year

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must upload signed tender document signed by the tenderer or by his authorized signatory
